lineage.description: IOM DTM Emergency Event Tracking deploys rapid assessment teams to document sudden displacement events in Ag Geneina, Sudan, recording displacement scale and affected population counts across multiple rounds (R1-R25) to provide frequent updates on population movements during emergencies.
